# G10: 福元门 Fu Yuan Men

Gate in the garden walls

**3D object:** none yet.

## What we know

- **Name:** 福元门 Fu Yuan Men (S01 · confidence B)
- **Type:** gate in the walls (S01 · confidence B)
- **Note:** South wall. Written 福元门 on the plan; Malone's Fu Yuan Men, 'Happy Garden Gate' (S02), in the outside wall just south of group 40 and 300 yards east of the Great Palace Gate. Plan distance to G01: 1635 px. (S01)
- **How it was read:** sure (S01) *(research copy, not public)*

- **E0379** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考: the eighteen gates. 1780s · j80:6b-7a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_080.txt
  > 園内為門十八南曰大宫門曰左右門曰東西夾道門曰東西如意門曰福園門曰西南門曰水閘門曰藻園門東曰東樓門曰鐡門曰明春門曰隨墻門曰蘂珠宫門西曰隨墻門正北曰北樓門為閘三西南為一空進水閘東北為五空出水閘為一空出水閘
  The Qing list of the gates of 圆明园 and of its three sluices, to set against the labels of S01.
- **E0382** (text, sure): 福園門 in front of 洞天深处. 1780s · j82:28b · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_082.txt
  > 洞天深處在如意館西稍南前宇乃諸皇子所居為四所東西二街南北一街前為福園門
  S01 writes 福元门. The texts write 福园门. The form 福元 is itself on a Yangshi Lei plan: S337 (三幅样式雷) reports 福元四所 on sheet 043-002 for the same place.
- **E0383** (text, sure): 宣宗實錄: stone roads to 福园门 and 西南门, 1828. 道光八年十二月 · 道光八年十二月戊寅 (corpus copy) · S208. https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录道光朝实录.txt
  > 所有西直门至圆明园、及阜成门西便门福园门西南门扇子河南岸、并佟府栅栏内外石道桥座涵洞等项工程
  Works on the stone roads to the garden name these two as road ends, so both were public approaches.
- **E0384** (text, sure): 宣宗實錄: 福园门 guarded, 1830. 道光十年十月 · 道光十年十月乙巳 (corpus copy) · S208. https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录道光朝实录.txt
  > 大阿哥因病未痊。住圆明园。……仪亲王于十八日前往看视。径入福园门、至阿哥所内。当时值班官兵及太监等拦阻不听
  Daoguang reprimands 仪亲王 for walking in past the guards to the sick eldest son: this gate led straight to the princes' courts.
- **E0397** (text, sure): 文宗實錄: 绮春园大宫门 and 福园门, 1850. 道光三十年二月 (after the Dowager's death) · 道光三十年二月戊辰 (corpus copy) · S207. https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录咸丰朝实录.txt
  > 大行皇太后梓宫、奉移昌陵隆恩殿暂安。届期。朕于绮春园大宫门跪送后。仍步行恭送至红桥。用申哀悃。俟梓宫渐远。朕进福园门。还飞云轩倚庐。
  The Emperor sees the coffin off at the great gate of Qichun Yuan, walks on to 红桥, and comes back in through 福园门 to his mourning place in 飞云轩.
- **E0385** (description, sure): Malone on 福园门. 1934 · p.96 · S02. https://archive.org/details/historyofpekings00malo
  Fu Yuan Men stands in the outer wall just south of group 40, about 300 yards directly east of the Great Palace Gate; he says the woodcut of scene 40 shows it, the painting does not.
- **E0389** (description, likely): 围墙 and gates between the three gardens (S57 = S116). 2021, on Yangshi Lei wall plans · section 1.2, 3.3 · S57. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202108/t20210831_4483376.html
  Between 圆明园 and 长春园: 明春门, 绿油门, 蕊珠门. Between 绮春园 and 长春园: 茜园门. Between 绮春园 and 圆明园: 秀清村门. Today's wall file names 藻园门, 西爽村门, 运料门, 绿油门, 福缘门 and 东楼门 as sites of wall gates, 西北门 and 大北门 by their walls. 绿油门 is not labelled on S01.

**On the plan:** Drawn as a gate on the plan of the gardens (S01). https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
